related.title: 衛星姿態量測與控制概念
related.titleEn: Satellite attitude sensing and control concepts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學 P0 至少 0.90 時修正模型通過，但不能由此宣稱元件已具太空等級。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The corrected model passes a teaching P0 target of 0.90 but does not establish space qualification. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 由三角速度軌跡估算轉矩需求，區分轉角、角速度與角加速度。
related.differenceEn: Estimate torque for a triangular rate profile, distinguishing angle, rate and angular acceleration.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學未修正錯誤率 0.02 次/日，觀察 30 日。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P0=exp(−0.02×30)。 結果約 0.548812 fraction。固定獨立事件率 λ 下 P0=e^(−λt)；突發事件和共因效應違反此近似。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單軸慣量 12 kg m²、轉角 90°=π/2 rad、總時間 60 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：τ=12×4×(π/2)/60²。 結果約 0.020944 N m。對稱加減速總角度 θ、總時間 T 時 α=4θ/T²，τ=Iα；忽略耦合、摩擦及柔性模態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching uncorrected-event rate is 0.02 per day over 30 days. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: P0=exp(−0.02×30). Result ≈ 0.548812 fraction. For constant independent rate λ, P0=e^(−λt); bursts and common-cause effects violate the approximation.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching single-axis inertia is 12 kg m², angle 90°=π/2 rad and total time 60 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: τ=12×4×(π/2)/60². Result ≈ 0.020944 N m. For symmetric acceleration/deceleration, α=4θ/T² and torque τ=Iα, excluding coupling, friction and flexible modes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 在共同可見時窗內排定資料轉送，區分接觸時間、有效酬載與傳播延遲。
related.differenceEn: Schedule relay inside a common visibility window while separating contact time, useful payload and propagation delay.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學未修正錯誤率 0.02 次/日，觀察 30 日。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P0=exp(−0.02×30)。 結果約 0.548812 fraction。固定獨立事件率 λ 下 P0=e^(−λt)；突發事件和共因效應違反此近似。
手算有效秒數 550，依序換算 Mbit 與 MB，再填 80 MB 和 40 MB 的排程。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching uncorrected-event rate is 0.02 per day over 30 days. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: P0=exp(−0.02×30). Result ≈ 0.548812 fraction. For constant independent rate λ, P0=e^(−λt); bursts and common-cause effects violate the approximation.
Compute 550 useful seconds, convert Mbit to MB and attempt an 80 MB plus 40 MB schedule.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
